title: Shanipar Ganpati (Shaniwarwada Ganpati)
text:
Shanipar Ganpati (Shaniwarwada Ganpati) (शनिपार गणपती (शनिवारवाडा गणपती)) — Iconic Sarvajanik Mandal, located in Near Shaniwarwada, Kasba Peth, Pune, established Early 20th century.

History: Shanipar Ganpati sits near the iconic Shaniwarwada fort, former seat of the Peshwa empire, giving it unique historical gravitas. It is popular with tourists visiting Shaniwarwada who combine their heritage visit with Ganpati darshan; during Ganeshotsav the surrounding area comes alive with processions reflecting old Pune's petha-area festival spirit.

Idol/Deity: Traditional Ganpati idol in a historically rich setting near the Peshwa-era Shaniwarwada fort.

Temple/Mandir address: Near Shaniwarwada, Kasba Peth, Pune 411011. Festival pandal address: TO UPDATE — confirm 2026 pandal. Maps link: TO UPDATE — August 2026. Coordinates: 18.5196, 73.8553.
